snippets.why: Maps generic role names to five Math context files.
snippets.content:
189  def role_banner(role: str) -> str:
 190      """Load Math context as a Skill for the generic role implementation."""
 191      role_name = (role or "").strip().lower()
 192      skill_name = {
 193          "manager": "manager/math-research-manager.md",
 194          "planner": "planner/math-research-planning.md",
 195          "engineer": "engineer/math-research-execution.md",
 196          "reviewer": "reviewer/math-research-review.md",
 197          "scientist": "scientist/math-research-adaptation.md",
 198      }.get(role_name)
 199      if skill_name is None:
 200          return ""
 201      text = (Path(__file__).parent / "skills" / skill_name).read_text(
 202          encoding="utf-8"
 203      )
 204      if text.startswith("---"):
 205          _frontmatter, _separator, body = text[3:].partition("---")
 206          return body.strip()
 207      return text.strip()

snippets.title: Lean proof-hole lexer
snippets.why: Rejects real sorry/admit/axiom/constant while ignoring comments and strings.
snippets.content:
286  def find_proof_holes(source: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
 287      """Find real ``sorry``/``admit`` identifiers with a small Lean lexer."""
 288      holes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
 289      index = 0
 290      line = 1
 291      block_depth = 0
 292      in_string = False
 293      escaped = False
 294      while index < len(source):
 295          current = source[index]
 296          pair = source[index : index + 2]
 297          if block_depth:
 298              if pair == "/-":
 299                  block_depth += 1
 300                  index += 2
 301                  continue
 302              if pair == "-/":
 303                  block_depth -= 1
 304                  index += 2
 305                  continue
 306              if current == "\n":
 307                  line += 1
 308              index += 1
 309              continue
 310          if in_string:
 311              if current == "\n":
 312                  line += 1
 313              if escaped:
 314                  escaped = False
 315              elif current == "\\":
 316                  escaped = True
 317              elif current == '"':
 318                  in_string = False
 319              index += 1
 320              continue
 321          if pair == "--":
 322              newline = source.find("\n", index + 2)
 323              if newline < 0:
 324                  break
 325              line += 1
 326              index = newline + 1
 327              continue
 328          if pair == "/-":
 329              block_depth = 1
 330              index += 2
 331              continue
 332          raw_end = _raw_string_end(source, index)
 333          if raw_end is not None:
 334              line += source.count("\n", index, raw_end)
 335              index = raw_end
 336              continue
 337          if current == "«":
 338              end = source.find("»", index + 1)
 339              if end < 0:
 340                  line += source.count("\n", index)
 341                  break
 342              line += source.count("\n", index, end + 1)
 343              index = end + 1
 344              continue
 345          if current == '"':
 346              in_string = True
 347              index += 1
 348              continue
 349          if current.isalpha() or current == "_":
 350              end = index + 1
 351              while end < len(source) and (
 352                  source[end].isalnum() or source[end] in {"_", "'"}
 353              ):
 354                  end += 1
 355              token = source[index:end]
 356              if token in {"sorry", "admit", "axiom", "constant"}:
 357                  holes.append({"kind": token, "line": line})
 358              index = end
 359              continue
 360          if current == "\n":
 361              line += 1
 362          index += 1
 363      return holes

snippets.title: Generic research completion and pause contract
snippets.why: Separates bounded completion, target-level breakthroughs, and pause statuses.
snippets.content:
224  def research_completion_issue(
 225      value: Any,
 226      *,
 227      research_target_level: str | None,
 228      scope: str = "",
 229  ) -> str:
 230      target = normalize_research_target_level(research_target_level)
 231      if target is None:
 232          return ""
 233      result = normalize_research_result(value)
 234      if result is None:
 235          return "missing_or_invalid_research_result"
 236      result_class = result["result_class"]
 237      correctness = result["correctness_status"]
 238      novelty = result["novelty_status"]
 239      significance = result["significance_status"]
 240      fidelity = result["statement_fidelity_status"]
 241      if not result["evidence"]:
 242          return "missing_research_evidence"
 243      if correctness != "verified":
 244          return "correctness_not_verified"
 245      if fidelity == "failed":
 246          return "statement_fidelity_failed"
 247      if str(scope or "").strip().lower() == "bounded":
 248          # A bounded backlog item certifies only its own acceptance criteria, not
 249          # the persisted project-level research target.  Keep the structured
 250          # result and evidence checks above, but leave terminal novelty and
 251          # significance to final-submission missions.
 252          return ""
 253      if target == "exploratory":
 254          if result_class not in _EXPLORATORY_TERMINAL_CLASSES:
 255              return f"result_class_not_exploratory_terminal:{result_class}"
 256          if novelty == "unverified" and result_class not in {
 257              "structured_failure_report",
 258              "honest_final_report",
 259          }:
 260              return "novelty_not_verified"
 261          return ""
 262      if result_class not in _BREAKTHROUGH_CLASSES:
 263          return f"result_class_below_{target}:{result_class}"
 264      if novelty != "verified_new":
 265          return "novelty_not_verified_new"
 266      if significance not in {"publishable", "doctoral"}:
 267          return f"significance_below_{target}:{significance}"
 268      return ""
 269  
 270  
 271  def research_pause_status(value: Any) -> str:
 272      result = normalize_research_result(value)
 273      if result is None:
 274          return "research_incomplete"
 275      if result["result_class"] == "exhausted_current_methods":
 276          return "exhausted_current_methods"
 277      if result["result_class"] in {
 278          "structured_failure_report",
 279          "honest_final_report",
 280      }:
 281          return "paused_no_breakthrough"
 282      return "research_incomplete"

snippets.title: Generic lifecycle resume/archive
snippets.why: Math reuses the project lifecycle rather than owning its own pause/resume state machine.
snippets.content:
312  def resume(
 313      status: ProjectStatus, *, now: datetime | None = None, reason: str = "user_resume"
 314  ) -> tuple[ProjectStatus, LifecycleEvent]:
 315      """User reopens a blocked project in its observable working state."""
 316      if status.state not in (
 317          ProjectState.QUARANTINED,
 318          ProjectState.DONE,
 319          ProjectState.ARCHIVED,
 320      ):
 321          raise ValueError(
 322              f"cannot resume project in state {status.state.value!r}"
 323          )
 324      now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 325      # Heuristic: if there's no evidence yet → incubating; if there's a draft
 326      # → writing; otherwise running.
 327      if status.has_draft:
 328          target = ProjectState.WRITING
 329      elif status.last_evidence_at is None:
 330          target = ProjectState.INCUBATING
 331      else:
 332          target = ProjectState.RUNNING
 333      event = LifecycleEvent(
 334          at=now,
 335          from_state=status.state,
 336          to_state=target,
 337          reason=reason,
 338      )
 339      return apply_event(status, event), event
 340  
 341  
 342  def archive(
 343      status: ProjectStatus,
 344      *,
 345      now: datetime | None = None,
 346      reason: str = "user_archive",
 347  ) -> tuple[ProjectStatus, LifecycleEvent]:
 348      """User closes out a project (done or quarantined). Terminal."""
 349      if status.state == ProjectState.ARCHIVED:
 350          raise ValueError("project already archived")
 351      now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 352      event = LifecycleEvent(
 353          at=now,
 354          from_state=status.state,
 355          to_state=ProjectState.ARCHIVED,
 356          reason=reason,
 357      )
 358      return apply_event(status, event), event
